title: Spinning States and Unitarity in 3D Gravity
summary: We revisit the proposal to cure the negative density of states in the three-dimensional gravitational path integral by adding spinning states whose spin scales with the central charge. We show that sub-extremal and extremal spinning states below the black hole threshold, together with certain overspinning states above it, can cancel the known negativities in the spectrum. We interpret the states below threshold as bulk spinning defects.
